<BEGIN_SHACL>
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

# Shape applied to every ship instance in the admitted population
<https://w3id.org/nltl/shapes/ShipIceAccretionPreventionShape>
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#ship> ;
    sh:message "When ice accretion is likely, every required navigation or communication antenna must be equipped with means to prevent ice accumulation." ;
    sh:sparql [
        a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
        sh:select """
            SELECT ?this ?antenna
            WHERE {
                ?this a <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#ship> ;
                      <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#iceAccretionLikely> true ;
                      <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#hasRequiredNavigationOrCommunicationAntenna> ?antenna .
                FILTER NOT EXISTS {
                    ?antenna <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#antennaIceAccumulationPreventionPresent> true .
                }
            }
        """ ;
        sh:message "Required navigation/communication antenna {$antenna} lacks ice‑accumulation‑prevention means while ice accretion is likely on the ship." ;
    ] .
<END_SHACL>
